verses.text_urhobo: Ọke ri Rachel vwọ mrẹ nẹ ọye rhe vwiẹ-ẹ, kọ rioma kpahe oniọvo rọye; ọ da ta ki Jekọp nẹ, Kẹ vwẹ ọmọ, ọ rha dia ọtiọye ki mi ghwu;
verses.text_romanized: oke ri rachel vwo mre ne oye rhe vwie e ko rioma kpahe oniovo roye o da ta ki jekop ne ke vwe omo o rha dia otioye ki mi ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ophu de mu Jekọp kpahe Rachel, ọ da ta, Mẹvwẹ Ọghẹnẹ rọ karo owẹ evwiẹ?
verses.text_romanized: ophu de mu jekop kpahe rachel o da ta mevwe oghene ro karo owe evwie

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ọ da ta, Ọmọtẹ mẹ re se Bilhah na; bro ra rere ovwiẹ kẹ vwẹ, re emọ ro vwori ejobi kẹ mẹvwẹ ri vwiẹ ayen.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin o da ta omote me re se bilhah na bro ra rere ovwie ke vwe re emo ro vwori ejobi ke mevwe ri vwie ayen

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da vwi Bilhah kẹ vwọ rọvwọ: Jekọp de nene vwerhẹ
verses.text_romanized: o da vwi bilhah ke vwo rovwo jekop de nene vwerhe

verses.text_urhobo: Bilhah da mrevun o de vwiẹ ọmọshare ki Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: bilhah da mrevun o de vwie omoshare ki jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Rachel da ta, Ọghẹnẹ bru orhiẹ kẹ vwẹ, o de nyo urhuru mẹ ọ da kẹ vwẹ ọmọshare; o de mu odẹ kẹ nẹ Dan.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin rachel da ta oghene bru orhie ke vwe o de nyo urhuru me o da ke vwe omoshare o de mu ode ke ne dan

verses.text_urhobo: Ọmọtẹ ri Rachel na Bilhah da rhoma mrevun o de vwiẹ ọmọshare ki Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: omote ri rachel na bilhah da rhoma mrevun o de vwie omoshare ki jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Rachel da ta, Ogangan mẹ vẹ oniọvo mẹ vwo muabọ Me da marọ, Etiyin o de se odẹ rọye Naftali.
verses.text_romanized: rachel da ta ogangan me ve oniovo me vwo muabo me da maro etiyin o de se ode roye naftali

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Leah rha vwọ mrẹ nẹ ọye gbi vwiẹ-ẹ, ọ da reyọ ọmọtẹ rọye Zilpah vwọ ki Jekọp vwọ rọvwọ.
verses.text_romanized: ri leah rha vwo mre ne oye gbi vwie e o da reyo omote roye zilpah vwo ki jekop vwo rovwo

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ọmọtẹ ri Leah Zilpah de vwiẹ ọmọshare ki Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin omote ri leah zilpah de vwie omoshare ki jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Leah da ta, Mi yovwerhi, Etiyin o de mu odẹ kẹ ni Gad;
verses.text_romanized: leah da ta mi yovwerhi etiyin o de mu ode ke ni gad

verses.text_urhobo: ọmọtẹ ri Leah Zilpah da rhoma vwiẹ ọmọshare ọfa ki Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: omote ri leah zilpah da rhoma vwie omoshare ofa ki jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Leah da ta, Komavọ Me ghọghọ te, kidie eya na ki se vwe aghọghọ; Etiyin o de se odẹ rọye Asha.
verses.text_romanized: leah da ta komavo me ghogho te kidie eya na ki se vwe aghogho etiyin o de se ode roye asha

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke orhọ rẹ eka Rubẹn da mrẹ ivwritegbo vwẹ obo ẹghwa, ọ da vwẹ ayen rhe oni rọye Leah. Etiyin Rachel da ta ki Leah, Biko, Me rẹ wẹ, kẹ vwẹ ivwritegbo rẹ ọmọ wẹn na.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke orho re eka ruben da mre ivwritegbo vwe obo eghwa o da vwe ayen rhe oni roye leah etiyin rachel da ta ki leah biko me re we ke vwe ivwritegbo re omo wen na

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da ta kẹ, Wo rori nẹ emu otete ru wo vwo mie vwe ọshare mẹ? Wo ji mie vwe ivwritegbo rẹ ọmọ mẹ rhe? Rachel da ta, Ko nene uwe vwerhẹ ason na fiki rẹ ivwritegbo rẹ ọmọ wẹn na.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo o da ta ke wo rori ne emu otete ru wo vwo mie vwe oshare me wo ji mie vwe ivwritegbo re omo me rhe rachel da ta ko nene uwe vwerhe ason na fiki re ivwritegbo re omo wen na

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Jekọp vwo nẹ ẹghwa rhe vwẹ ovwọnvwọn Leah da ra vwa, ọ da ta, Wo bru vwe rhe ovwerhẹ, kidie Me vwẹ ivwritegbo re ọmọ mẹ vwọ yaro wẹ. Kọye o de nene vwerhẹ vwẹ ason yena.
verses.text_romanized: ri jekop vwo ne eghwa rhe vwe ovwonvwon leah da ra vwa o da ta wo bru vwe rhe ovwerhe kidie me vwe ivwritegbo re omo me vwo yaro we koye o de nene vwerhe vwe ason yena

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ de nyo enuebro ri Leah, ọ da mrevun o de vwiẹ ọmọshare rẹ iyori ki Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: oghene de nyo enuebro ri leah o da mrevun o de vwie omoshare re iyori ki jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Leah da ta, Ọghẹnẹ hwosa rẹ oyare mẹ kẹ vwẹ nure kidie Me vwẹ ọmọtẹ mẹ vwọ kẹ ọshare mẹ, o de se odẹ rọye Isaka.
verses.text_romanized: leah da ta oghene hwosa re oyare me ke vwe nure kidie me vwe omote me vwo ke oshare me o de se ode roye isaka

verses.text_urhobo: Leah da rhoma mrevun, o de vwiẹ ọmọshare rẹ esan vwọ ki Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: leah da rhoma mrevun o de vwie omoshare re esan vwo ki jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Leah da ta, Ọghẹnẹ nẹrhẹ e ru emu aye kẹ vwẹ; vwẹ etinẹ na ọshare mẹ ko mu ọghọ kẹ vwẹ fikiridie mi vwiẹ emọ esan vwọ kẹ; o de se odẹ rọye Zẹbulọn.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin leah da ta oghene nerhe e ru emu aye ke vwe vwe etine na oshare me ko mu ogho ke vwe fikiridie mi vwie emo esan vwo ke o de se ode roye zebulon

verses.text_urhobo: Ukuko rọye o de vwiẹ ọmọtẹ, o de se odẹ rọye Dinah.
verses.text_romanized: ukuko roye o de vwie omote o de se ode roye dinah

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ ke rhe karohọ Rachel, Ọghẹnẹ de nyo oviẹ rọye o de rhie urhoro rọye.
verses.text_romanized: oghene ke rhe karoho rachel oghene de nyo ovie roye o de rhie urhoro roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da mrevun o de vwiẹ ọmọshare, ọ da ta, Ọghẹnẹ si vwe nẹ ehwẹjẹ;
verses.text_romanized: o da mrevun o de vwie omoshare o da ta oghene si vwe ne ehweje

verses.text_urhobo: o de se odẹ rọye Josẹf, tanẹ, Je Ọrovwohwo vwẹ ọmọ ọfa vwo ba kẹ vwẹ,
verses.text_romanized: o de se ode roye josef tane je orovwohwo vwe omo ofa vwo ba ke vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ri Rachel vwo vwiẹ Josẹf nu, Jekọp da ta ki Laban, Gbe si obo nu vwe, rere mi kpo uwevwi mẹ vẹ orho mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ri rachel vwo vwie josef nu jekop da ta ki laban gbe si obo nu vwe rere mi kpo uwevwi me ve orho me

verses.text_urhobo: Ke vwẹ eya mẹ vẹ emọ mẹ re Me ga ẹga rọye kẹ wẹ na, rere mi kpo, kidie wọ riẹn owian re Me wian kẹ wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ke vwe eya me ve emo me re me ga ega roye ke we na rere mi kpo kidie wo rien owian re me wian ke we

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Laban da ta kẹ, Wọ da rhọvwe kẹ vwẹ ne Me ta ọtiọye, ke Me ta nẹ a mraro kẹ vwẹ ni fiki wẹ ọye Ọrovwohwo vwo bruphihọ kẹ vwẹ,
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo laban da ta ke wo da rhovwe ke vwe ne me ta otioye ke me ta ne a mraro ke vwe ni fiki we oye orovwohwo vwo bruphiho ke vwe

verses.text_urhobo: se osa re Me re wẹ re Me hwa kẹ wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: se osa re me re we re me hwa ke we

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da ta kẹ, Wẹ vẹ ekpuyovwi wẹn riẹnre obo Me ga wẹ te, obo re uchuru wẹn yovwi te vwẹ obọ mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ta ke we ve ekpuyovwi wen rienre obo me ga we te obo re uchuru wen yovwi te vwe obo me

verses.text_urhobo: Kidie uchuru wẹn pha tutuno vwẹ ọke re Me vwọ rhe, nẹ ọke yena rhe na i de bu gangan, Ọrovwohwo de bruphihọ kẹ wẹ vwi kabọ kabọ. Asakiephana kẹ ọke vọ Me rha vwọ wian kẹ omobọ mẹ?
verses.text_romanized: kidie uchuru wen pha tutuno vwe oke re me vwo rhe ne oke yena rhe na i de bu gangan orovwohwo de bruphiho ke we vwi kabo kabo asakiephana ke oke vo me rha vwo wian ke omobo me

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta, Kidie Me kẹ wẹ? Jekọp da kpahe, Wọ kẹ vwẹ emuọvo-o; wo de se ru Ọnana kẹ vwẹ, ke Me rhoma churu igodẹ wẹn na Me Me rha sẹro rẹ ayen.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta kidie me ke we jekop da kpahe wo ke vwe emuovo o wo de se ru onana ke vwe ke me rhoma churu igode wen na me me rha sero re ayen

verses.text_urhobo: ju vwe wan uherevie rẹ igodẹ wẹ na nonẹ, rere Me sanọ igodẹ ri kere ipe kugbe emọ rẹ igodẹ rẹ ibiebi, kugbe ẹvwe ri kere ipe ejobi, eyena keye dia osa mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ju vwe wan uherevie re igode we na none rere me sano igode ri kere ipe kugbe emo re igode re ibiebi kugbe evwe ri kere ipe ejobi eyena keye dia osa me

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin kọye wo de vughe ọvwata mẹ vwobọ, vwẹ ọke ri wọ da cha mrẹ osa mẹ. Kogodẹ kogodẹ eyẹ ẹvwe ro rhe vwo upee eyẹ obirii, wọ da mrẹ vwẹ ohri rẹ emẹ na, ji mi choro.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin koye wo de vughe ovwata me vwobo vwe oke ri wo da cha mre osa me kogode kogode eye evwe ro rhe vwo upee eye obirii wo da mre vwe ohri re eme na ji mi choro

verses.text_urhobo: Laban da ta, Oyoma gbe jọ dia obo wọ tare na.
verses.text_romanized: laban da ta oyoma gbe jo dia obo wo tare na

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo ẹdẹ yena Laban da sanọ egbo kugbe ẹkpro ri keri ipe kugbe iri vwo irhiẹ, iri vwo ipe efuanfon, kugbe ipe ibiebi, ọ da sanọ ayen ejobi vwọ kẹ emọ rọye ni sun;
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ede yena laban da sano egbo kugbe ekpro ri keri ipe kugbe iri vwo irhie iri vwo ipe efuanfon kugbe ipe ibiebi o da sano ayen ejobi vwo ke emo roye ni sun

verses.text_urhobo: o de phi uvwre rẹ oyan rẹ ẹdọke erha vwọ kẹ oma rọye vi Jekọp; Jekọp da ghẹrẹ igodẹ ri Laban ri chekọ.
verses.text_romanized: o de phi uvwre re oyan re edoke erha vwo ke oma roye vi jekop jekop da ghere igode ri laban ri cheko

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Jekọp da reyọ oghọ ọkpokpọ ri almond kugbe afon ọ da phia, o de kere fuanfon, ọ da vwẹ ẹbẹre ro kerẹ na vwọ phia.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin jekop da reyo ogho okpokpo ri almond kugbe afon o da phia o de kere fuanfon o da vwe ebere ro kere na vwo phia

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da vwẹ oghọ ro keri fuanfon na vwọ rẹrẹ asan rẹ igodẹ na da da ame. Kidie ẹvo vwiẹ vwẹ asan rẹ ayen da da ame na,
verses.text_romanized: o da vwe ogho ro keri fuanfon na vwo rere asan re igode na da da ame kidie evo vwie vwe asan re ayen da da ame na

verses.text_urhobo: igodẹ na de vwiẹ vwẹ obaro rẹ oghọ rẹ urhe ro keri ipe na, ẹvo de vwiẹ iri vẹ ipe efuanfon, ẹvo vẹ irhiẹ efa ibiebi.
verses.text_romanized: igode na de vwie vwe obaro re ogho re urhe ro keri ipe na evo de vwie iri ve ipe efuanfon evo ve irhie efa ibiebi

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da hẹriẹ imigodẹ na, o de hirhe opharo rẹ igodẹ na ku oghọ rẹ urhe re keri na kugbe ibiebi re igodẹ ri Laban, o de phi ekru rẹ igodẹ robọ rọye phi orhọ o rhe ku ayen kugbe iri Laban na-a.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da herie imigode na o de hirhe opharo re igode na ku ogho re urhe re keri na kugbe ibiebi re igode ri laban o de phi ekru re igode robo roye phi orho o rhe ku ayen kugbe iri laban na a

verses.text_urhobo: Kọke kọke rẹ igodẹ re sasare de vwiẹ Jekọp mi phi oghọ na phihọ asan rẹ igodẹ da da ame asan rẹ igodẹ na da sa mrẹ, rere ayen vwo vwiẹ vwẹ obaro rẹ oghọ na,
verses.text_romanized: koke koke re igode re sasare de vwie jekop mi phi ogho na phiho asan re igode da da ame asan re igode na da sa mre rere ayen vwo vwie vwe obaro re ogho na

verses.text_urhobo: ẹkẹvuọvo ere pha mwẹmwẹ re herọ o de mu ayen san, ere mwẹmwẹ na ke rẹ Laban, ere gangan ri chekọ ki ri Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ere pha mwemwe re hero o de mu ayen san ere mwemwe na ke re laban ere gangan ri cheko ki ri jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Kẹnẹ Jekọp ru fe gangan, o de vwo uchuru, kugbe idibo rẹ emetẹ vẹ ere eshare kugbe iyesi vẹ ekẹtẹkẹtẹ.
verses.text_romanized: kene jekop ru fe gangan o de vwo uchuru kugbe idibo re emete ve ere eshare kugbe iyesi ve eketekete

headings.text_urhobo: Jekọp vẹ Laban de vẹ obo rọ ga Ẹga na wan
headings.text_romanized: jekop ve laban de ve obo ro ga ega na wan
